طَاجَنٌ , (S,) or طَاجِنٌ, (T,) or both, (Msb, TA, and in a copy of the S written طَاجَنٌ,) and ↓ طَيْجَنٌ , (S, Msb, K,) A frying-pan; syn. مِقْلًى; (Msb;) a طَابَق upon which one fries: (S, K:) arabicized words, (S, Msb, K,) because ط and ج do not occur in the original language of the Arabs: (S, TA:) [app. from the Greek
τήγανον :] the pl. of طاجن is طَوَاجِنُ; (Msb, TA;) and that of ↓ طيجن is طَيَاجِنُ, (Msb,) or طَيَاجِينُ. (MA, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
